strings.band.above.label: 🙂 Above Average!
strings.band.above.text: You have a decent level of likability. You get along well with most people, but enhancing your listening skills and empathy could make you even more approachable.
strings.band.average.label: 😐 Average
strings.band.average.text: You have moderate likability. Working on your social skills, positivity, and showing more genuine interest in others would significantly improve how people perceive you.
strings.band.excellent.label: 😊 Excellent!
strings.band.excellent.text: You are very likeable! You have great interpersonal skills and people enjoy your company. You show genuine care for others and maintain positive relationships with ease.
strings.band.exceptional.label: 🌟 Exceptional!
strings.band.exceptional.text: You are extremely likeable! People naturally gravitate towards you. You possess outstanding social skills, genuine empathy, and a warm personality that makes others feel valued and appreciated.
strings.band.good.label: 👍 Good!
strings.band.good.text: You are quite likeable! You have solid social skills and generally make a positive impression. People feel comfortable around you, though there's always room to grow your likability score.
strings.band.low.label: 💪 Needs Work
strings.band.low.text: You have significant room to grow in terms of likability. Focus on empathy, positivity, reliability, and communication. Everyone can improve their likeability score with intentional practice!
strings.cat.excellent: Outstanding! You excel in this area.
strings.cat.good: Great work! You're doing well here.
strings.cat.low: Focus area. Work on developing this skill.
strings.dim.0.desc: How you come across to people who have just met you. Covers greeting behaviour, use of names, and the warmth you signal in initial encounters.
strings.dim.0.name: First Impressions
strings.dim.1.desc: How you listen, how you engage in conversation, and whether you maintain eye contact and make people feel genuinely heard.
strings.dim.1.name: Communication
strings.dim.2.desc: The general emotional tone you bring to interactions. Covers your outlook, how often you compliment others, and your gratitude habits.
strings.dim.2.name: Positivity
strings.dim.3.desc: Your genuine interest in others’ experiences and how well you tune into their feelings. This is one of the strongest individual predictors of likeability.
strings.dim.3.name: Empathy
strings.dim.4.desc: How you handle disagreement, criticism, and pressure. Covers conflict resolution, boundary respect, and composure under stress.
strings.dim.4.name: Emotional Intelligence
strings.dim.5.desc: Whether you help others without being asked, share credit for shared successes, and celebrate others’ achievements genuinely.
strings.dim.5.name: Kindness
strings.dim.6.desc: Whether people can count on you. Covers punctuality, commitment to promises, and consistency in your behaviour over time.
strings.dim.6.name: Reliability
strings.dim.7.desc: Your honesty, whether you gossip, and whether you admit when you are wrong. Trust is the foundation on which deep likeability is built.
strings.dim.7.name: Trustworthiness
strings.dim.8.desc: Your broader social flexibility — whether you can make people laugh, adapt to different personalities, and stay open-minded to views different from your own.
strings.dim.8.name: Social Skills
